Attempts to configure the Graph FIC for a managed identity in a different AAD tenant than the user's auth profile. Acquires a Graph token for the MI's tenant via MSAL's WithTenantId override (requires the user to be a guest with sufficient permissions in the MI's tenant). Returns null if cross-tenant access is unavailable — caller falls back.
Any exception raised during the cross-tenant exchange (network failure, token broker error, MSAL exception) is swallowed and converted to a null return so the caller can surface a friendly manual-configuration message instead of crashing.

member.name: T:bolt.module.ppmi.Services.VersionUpgraders.PluginVersionUpgrader
member.summary:
Generic upgrader for Plugin components (PluginAssembly/PluginPackage). Each version transition is just "configure FIC using the target version's format, then bump the managed identity version to the target". The FIC format for each version lives in and is selected by passing the target version as versionOverride to .
Plugin version semantics: V0: legacy (no FIC, pre-FIC managed identity) V1: FIC with CN-based path (i/{issuer-CN}/s/{subject-CN}, h/{hash} for self-signed) V2: FIC with SHA256-hashed DN path (i/{issuer-DN-hash}/s/{subject-DN-hash}, h/{hash} for self-signed)
Any from→to within [V0, MaxSupportedVersion] is handled by a single instance — the verb constructs an instance with the desired (from, to) pair, eliminating per-transition upgrader classes (PluginV0ToV1Upgrader, PluginV1ToV2Upgrader, PluginV0ToV2Upgrader). To support a new version (e.g., V3), bump and add the new V3 segment format to .
